summary: Completed Day 7 Final Integration in namnx-vn/crm-demo. Main /customers flow now uses URL search/page as shareable state, parameterized TanStack Query keys, DummyJSON q/skip/limit, AbortSignal, loading/error/empty states, pagination, and Next loading/error boundaries. Main /customers/[id] now uses Server Component initial data plus CustomerDetailClient for edit mutation; success updates detail/list caches and invalidates/refetches detail. Existing learning demos were preserved. learning-plan/day-07-integration.md documents the integrated mental model, and learning-plan/README.md marks all 7 days complete. Direct local npm lint/build could not be run because the container cannot resolve github.com to clone/install; code was manually reviewed against current Next.js/TanStack Query docs. Next recommended step is user-run npm run lint && npm run build, followed by a short oral/code review to confirm mastery rather than just implementation completion.
